name: Puff | 510 Battery | Pink
description:
3.3V - 4.8V Adjustable Voltage
Preheat Function
TYPE-C Charging Cable Included

A 510 thread battery is the standard, universal power source for most vape pens, named for its 10-thread, 0.5mm connector that screws onto various cartridges (vape carts), heating the oil inside to create vapor for inhalation, offering features like auto-draw or button activation and variable voltage settings.
